rows.question: How long do I have to return something?

original.answer: You can return unworn items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery.[1]

edited.answer: You can return unworn items in their original packaging within 45 days of delivery.[1]

rows.question: How much is the MARINE set?

original.answer: The MARINE set costs £235.[1] It includes all five pieces from the MARINE collection.[1] Buying the set saves £37 compared with buying the pieces separately.[1]

edited.answer: The MARINE set costs £249.[1] It includes all five pieces from the MARINE collection.[1] Buying the set saves £23 compared with buying the pieces separately.[1]

rows.question: How long is the warranty on your jewellery?

original.answer: Our jewellery comes with a 12-month warranty against manufacturing faults.[1]

edited.answer: Our jewellery comes with a 24-month warranty against manufacturing faults.[1]

original.answer: UK delivery is free on orders over £100.[1][2] There is free UK express delivery on all LUNAR orders until 30 November 2026.[2]

edited.answer: UK delivery is free on standard shipping for orders over £150.[1][2] There is also free UK express delivery on all LUNAR collection orders until 30 November 2026.[2]

rows.question: How quickly do you reply to emails?

original.answer: We reply to emails within two working days, Monday to Friday.[1]

edited.answer: We reply to emails within three working days, Monday to Friday.[1]

rows.question: How much is delivery to Europe?

original.answer: Delivery to Europe costs £9.95 and takes 4 to 7 working days.[1]

edited.answer: We do not list delivery prices to Europe in our current shipping policy.[1]
